shooting_over_roundoff.note: error on 400 cells over n^2 eps

film_surface_referenced_residual.note: the interior relation referenced to the surface values

film_closed_form_match_8_cells.note: the match does not depend on resolution

transient_grid_change.note: peak on 200 cells against 100 at 100 steps per decade, relative
